basics.name: Mohamed Shamil Abdul Salam
basics.label: Software Engineer | Backend Systems | Payments & E-Invoicing
basics.summary: Backend engineer building payment, accounting, and e-invoicing systems in Laravel, PHP, and MySQL, specializing in the controls around money movement: approval workflows, authorization, audit trails, and fraud prevention. Built ZATCA e-invoicing for Taxfly, a cloud accounting and POS platform, through to handover, and an independent compliance engine that passes ZATCA’s SDK validator.

work.name: Zil Money
highlights: Designed and built a middleware-based service-provider access layer that lets payroll and bookkeeping providers act in customer accounts without sharing API keys, covering 450 existing REST endpoints, 7 payment services, and 38 webhook event types without per-endpoint changes.

Made provider access fail closed: every call is audited (refused if the audit write fails), refusals return a uniform 403 so customers can’t be enumerated, and payments assigned to the customer’s own approvers stay out of providers’ reach.

Prevented post-approval changes to payee bank details: fingerprinted the destination at creation, re-validated 3 bank fields at release, locked 3 payee/bank edit paths while payments were pending, and returned clear refusal reasons across 4 approval entry points.

Fixed recurring payments running against deleted payees or bank accounts across 5 payment types and 4 deletion paths, using model observers with bulk deletes routed through the same per-record path, and fixed a bulk-cancel bug that cancelled only the last of the selected schedules.
Maintained Positive Pay file generation for 17 banks across CSV, XLSX, and TXT formats, and fixed a server vs. US Eastern time zone mismatch that silently skipped runs scheduled after 8 PM.

Traced backend controls for identity verification, access control, payment validation, and account closure to their implementation in code and database records for the SOC 1 audit, and wrote read-only SQL queries that produced the auditors’ populations and samples.

Built check-import and printing flows: split merged payroll PDFs into per-check documents, creating checks only after user confirmation, and built the import for a custom SAP check-export format with background printing and a two-up legal check layout.
Built per-call cost, token, and latency tracking for 16 AI features across 18 call sites, with a dashboard breaking down usage, spend, and failures by feature, model, and provider account.

work.name: Netplex Solutions
highlights: Independently built ZATCA e-invoicing for Taxfly, a cloud accounting and POS product, through to handover: XML generation, signing, hashing, TLV QR codes, and certificate creation. Investigated compliance failures.
Built parts of Taxfly’s accounting module, including general ledger and trial balance reports and related accounting features.

Documented an existing Laravel and MySQL business platform end to end, from routes, controllers, models, and Blade views to roles and data, to scope its modular redesign for customers in Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE.
Developed parts of the platform redesign using Laravel, PHP, PostgreSQL, Inertia, Vue, and TypeScript, turning clients’ requirements into modular application workflows.

work.name: Inker Robotics
highlights: Supported web development, testing, and documentation, and assisted technical training sessions and assessments.

work.name: Cert-Ed Academia
highlights: Managed documentation, digital assets, and financial records, calculated working hours and prepared salary and fee amounts, and produced receipts, letterheads, and other business materials.
Later built the academy’s live education platform (see Projects).

projects.name: Cert-Ed Academia
highlights: Developed a live 5-role education platform covering classes, assignments, grading, per-session attendance, hours-based billing, receipts, payslips, messaging, and scheduling.
Enforced access through 18 application-level capabilities and 50+ PostgreSQL row-level security policies, supported by 100+ unit tests and per-role database checks in CI.

projects.name: Masaar
highlights: Building a ZATCA Phase 2 compliance engine with UBL invoice XML, cryptographic signing, hash chaining, and TLV QR codes; generated invoices pass ZATCA’s official SDK validator (26 checks), with certificate checks and live Fatoora submission next.

projects.name: Athar
highlights: Prototyping a security runtime with a Rust service and PHP/Laravel adapter that links payment events into lifecycles, records decision reasoning, and maintains a hash-chained, signed audit log.

projects.name: Time
highlights: Built a work-hours tracker used daily by 10+ colleagues and evolved it into a serverless multi-user service with hourly data synchronization.

quickView.role: Software Engineer · Backend systems · Financial workflows
quickView.line: I build backend systems for financial workflows, where a mistake costs money or trust: who can act on an account, payments that must go where they were approved, and compliance. Laravel and TypeScript, with tests and logs to prove it works.

results.text: Providers work through the existing payment APIs with single-use keys, every call audited and every refusal identical.
Bank details are locked in at submission and re-checked before money moves.
XML generation, signing, hashing, QR codes and compliance-error investigation, developed up to handover.
